summary: Independent verifier reviewed TASK-0026 PlanDraft-to-PlanIR implementation. The Scheduler boundary accepts PlanIR only, invalid plans fail closed, canonical digests are deterministic, PlanPatch creates a new version without parent mutation, PlanValidationReport is schema-backed and artifact-addressable, and domain/compiler code has no concrete model or workflow SDK imports.

criteria.criterion: The Scheduler-facing API accepts PlanIR only and cannot receive PlanDraft.
criteria.notes: ports.py exposes SchedulerPort.submit_plan(plan: PlanIR, validation_report: PlanValidationReport) and contains no PlanDraft reference; targeted test test_scheduler_port_accepts_plan_ir_not_plan_draft passed.

criteria.criterion: Cycles, missing refs, duplicate IDs, unbounded fan-out, absent Gate responsibility, uncovered Claims, invalid budgets and mutable latest refs fail closed.
criteria.notes: compile_plan_draft returns plan=None on validation errors. Tests and verifier probe covered cycles, missing refs, duplicate IDs, unbounded fan-out, missing Gate responsibility, uncovered Claims, invalid budgets, and mutable latest refs.

criteria.criterion: Canonical equivalent drafts compile to the same PlanIR digest.
criteria.notes: PlanIR digest uses canonical JSON via canonical_fingerprint and canonical node ordering; targeted digest determinism test passed.

criteria.criterion: A PlanPatch creates a new plan version and cannot mutate the parent.
criteria.notes: compile_plan_patch checks parent digest, emits parent.version + 1 with parent_plan_digest, and leaves the parent digest unchanged; targeted patch immutability test passed.

criteria.criterion: Validation reports are Artifacts suitable for Evidence references.
criteria.notes: PlanValidationReport has a contract schema/example, to_dict emits subjectRef, subjectDigest, result, errors, and refs, and the evidence manifests hash-address the report artifacts.

criteria.criterion: Domain/compiler code imports no concrete model or workflow SDK.
criteria.notes: src/ahra/plan_ir.py imports only stdlib and canonical_fingerprint; lint_contracts includes plan_ir.py and ports.py in forbidden SDK import scanning.

commands.command: uv run python -B -m unittest tests.test_plan_ir tests.test_schemas -v

commands.summary: 0 AHRA lint failures; Plan schemas/examples validated.
9 artifact/evidence records matched local SHA-256 values.
Duplicate node ID returned plan=None and included duplicate-node-id in validation errors; valid fixture compiled to a passed report.
